d31f936891e81a39a63f398c91051dfef9791782.summary: Unit 42 (Palo Alto Networks) describes WatchDog, a Monero cryptojacking campaign it says has run since January 2019 and has collected at least 209 XMR. The miner uses UPX-compressed Go binaries that can run on Windows and Linux. Its scanning component targets applications with built-in exploits, and it mines with XMRig. Researchers estimate at least 476 compromised systems mine at any one time. The report counts 18 IP addresses, seven domains and at least 125 URLs in its infrastructure. It compares the campaign with Graboid, a 2019 Docker Hub miner.
